Command: Bless the Israelites with the priestly blessing
Summary: The command: Bless the Israelites with the priestly blessing (Numbers 6:23). Aaron and his sons put the LORD's name upon Israel with the threefold blessing: the LORD bless thee, and keep thee.
Commandment: Bless the Israelites with the priestly blessing, as prescribed in Numbers 6:23.
Application: It cannot be practised as written without the standing temple and Aaronic priesthood; its enduring lesson is God's holiness, the cost of atonement, and worship offered exactly as God appoints.
Purpose: Scripture's stated purpose: they shall put my name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them (Numbers 6:27).
